name: Vimac
description: Sparkle EdDSA, but feed 410s — pointed at MS App Center's Sparkle relay, now shut down. Dead updater.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: In the reviewed Vimac snapshot, the macOS app points Sparkle at an api.appcenter.ms feed and embeds a SUPublicEDKey. The current availability of that external feed was not established from source.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; endpoint availability and historical feed responses require external publication evidence and were not inferred from source.

original_evidence.text: | Vimac | github.com/nchudleigh/vimac | **Sparkle (EdDSA = A)**, legacy `SUUpdater` 1.x API (CocoaPod `Sparkle (1.24.0)`) — **feed endpoint currently dead (HTTP 410)** | **Y** | **Y** (silent background check called automatically, not just a menu item) | **Y** (by code) — but non-functional today since the feed 410s | https | TLS-only (appcast itself unsigned) | signature[EdDSA] (by code); **currently unreachable in practice** | embedded in Info.plist (`SUPublicEDKey`) | `vimac/ViMac-Swift/Info.plist`: `SUFeedURL` = `https://api.appcenter.ms/v0.1/public/sparkle/apps/d28ff448-1768-4ee9-ab61-49f20cf5323e`, `SUPublicEDKey` = `OtDAJPNO6QsDcZeyySlbD9caJgxWoV/BA+rW9rfTKHM=`; `vimac/ViMac-Swift/AppDelegate.swift:84` `self.checkForUpdatesInBackground()` (called from `onAXPermissionGranted()`, i.e. on every normal launch), `:274-277` `func checkForUpdatesInBackground() { SUUpdater.shared()?.delegate = self; SUUpdater.shared()?.sendsSystemProfile = true; SUUpdater.shared()?.checkForUpdatesInBackground() }`; `vimac/ViMac-Swift/StatusItemManager.swift:42,72-73` "Check for updates" menu item → `SUUpdater.shared()?.checkForUpdates(nil)`; `Podfile.lock:12` `Sparkle (1.24.0)`. Live check `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.appcenter.ms/v0.1/public/sparkle/apps/d28ff448-1768-4ee9-ab61-49f20cf5323e` → **410** (Microsoft App Center's public service was retired/shut down; the Sparkle-compatible relay Vimac's feed depends on no longer exists). No Homebrew cask (404 on `Casks/v/vimac.rb`). |
